name: When should I consider professional help for wheelchair home modifications versus DIY?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider professional help for wheelchair home modifications versus DIY?

acceptedAnswer.text: Consider professional help for wheelchair home modifications when structural changes are involved, such as widening doorways, installing ramps, or remodeling bathrooms. Professionals ensure modifications meet safety standards, building codes, and provide optimal functionality. While simple tasks like repositioning furniture might be DIY, critical accessibility features require expert knowledge to avoid potential hazards and ensure long-term usability. A contractor also navigates permits and inspections efficiently.
acceptedAnswer.description: Seek professional help for structural changes like widening doorways or bathroom remodels to ensure safety, code compliance, and optimal functionality. DIY is suitable for minor, non-structural adjustments.
